standard.summary: LoRA 文件的基础名称（不含扩展名）。最终文件名为 {output_name}.safetensors。
standard.effect: 设置有意义的名称有助于区分不同实验（如 character_v1、style_watercolor）。
standard.whenToUse: 每次实验设置描述性名称，包含角色/风格名称和版本号。
standard.avoidWhen: 名称中避免使用空格或特殊字符，部分系统（A1111、ComfyUI）对文件名有限制。

standard_en.summary: The base name of the LoRA file (without the extension). The final filename is {output_name}.safetensors.
standard_en.effect: A meaningful name helps tell experiments apart (character_v1, style_watercolor and so on).
standard_en.whenToUse: Set a descriptive name for each experiment, including the character or style name and a version number.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Avoid spaces and special characters in the name; some systems (A1111, ComfyUI) restrict filenames.

advanced.principle: 中间 checkpoint 命名：{output_name}-{step}.safetensors；最终文件：{output_name}.safetensors。EMA 副本：{output_name}_ema.safetensors。
advanced.tradeoffs: 若文件名已存在，默认覆盖（不会添加序号）。建议每次修改参数时更新版本号。

advanced_en.principle: Intermediate checkpoint naming: {output_name}-{step}.safetensors; final file: {output_name}.safetensors. EMA copy: {output_name}_ema.safetensors.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: If the filename already exists it is overwritten by default (no sequence number is appended). Update the version number whenever you change parameters.
